content.short: Carbon Heavy is a multiplayer RTS focused on combat, diplomacy and trade, using blockchain technology.
content.description: Earth, 2057: after an AI uprising leaves most of humanity wiped out, Carbon Heavy invites you into a sprawling, massively multiplayer post-apocalyptic RTS. The game emphasizes combat, diplomacy, trade, and dynamic interactions with other players. Lead a small squad of mercenaries to conquer and harness the wasteland, hunt for oil—the currency that drives this world—build outposts, wage battles, trade, or ally with rivals, and push toward enough power to defeat the AI that now controls you. Forge alliances, manage scarce resources, and navigate competing factions amid ruins and peril.
content.meta: Carbon Heavy is a multiplayer post-apocalyptic RTS using blockchain. Discover Carbon Heavy and other Decentralized Games on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
